role: CI gate: StrapLinkCoordinator.linkEstablished must call `feed.start(`, and StrapHeartRateFeed must contain no readiness wait or sleep on heart rate.
toplevel: cd to repo root. COORDINATOR=$1 or Emuqu/Sources/Collection/StrapLinkCoordinator.swift; FEED=$2 or .../StrapHeartRateFeed.swift; missing -> 2. Python strips // tails; brace-matches the body of `func linkEstablished(` (missing -> 2); requires `struct StrapHeartRateFeed` (else 2); problems if no `feed.start(` or WAITS regex (awaitFeature/whenFeatureUsable/.../state(.heartRate, isHrStreamingReady, Task.sleep, sleepQuietly, sleepIgnoringCancellation) hits anywhere in the feed file -> exit 1. Wired: ci.yml and Makefile hr-feed-link-guard; not in gates.yml push run.
